meta.title: Global Graduate ML/AI Funding Tracker
meta.scope: Graduate-student-friendly conference grants, umbrella travel grants, and research programs that can fund conference/research travel. Accepted-paper-only grants are excluded from the default dataset.
meta.method: Official-source verification + conservative automatic deadline updates + separate discovery queue for new candidates.
meta.disclaimer: No public registry can guarantee every program in every country. This tracker is designed to expand continuously while keeping verified and unverified information separate.

programs.name: ACM-W Computer Science Research Conference Scholarship
programs.destination: Any eligible CS research conference worldwide
programs.amount: Up to $600 intra-continental; up to $1,200 intercontinental
coverage: Some ACM SIG conferences may also provide complimentary registration/mentoring
notCovered: Award may not cover the full trip
programs.paperRequirement: No paper or presentation is required.
programs.eligibility: Women students in computer science and related programs; conference may be ACM or non-ACM.
programs.membership: No ACM membership requirement stated on the scholarship page.
programs.payment: Scholarship award; conference-specific arrangements may vary.

programs.name: SIGCHI Gary Marsden Travel Awards
coverage: Travel support for attending SIGCHI conferences
notCovered: Exact amount and reimbursable categories depend on the award call
programs.paperRequirement: No accepted-paper requirement is stated for the general award; applicants choose a SIGCHI conference and apply early.
programs.eligibility: SIGCHI members who are students, early-career researchers, or facing financial hardship/lack of institutional support.
programs.payment: Award terms vary; consult the current call.

programs.name: USENIX Student Grants Program
notCovered: Student grants rarely cover every travel/hotel expense
programs.paperRequirement: Presenting is not required; presenters are eligible but not guaranteed support.
programs.eligibility: Full-time students at accredited institutions who otherwise lack funding.
programs.membership: USENIX membership is not stated as a requirement.
programs.payment: Registration code + travel/lodging grant paid after attendance.

programs.name: SIGWEB Fair Access Travel Grants
programs.destination: SIGWEB-supported conferences (e.g. WSDM, CIKM, UMAP, Web Science, JCDL)
programs.studentLevel: MSc / PhD / Postdoc / non-tenured early career
programs.amount: $10,000 total pool per supported conference; individual award varies
coverage: Visa-related costs where the event call permits
notCovered: Award size depends on applicants and travel distance
programs.paperRequirement: Applications may be submitted before acceptance; accepted presenters may receive preference.
programs.eligibility: Students and early researchers from economically developing countries; event-specific rules apply.

programs.name: AISB Student Grant
programs.field: Artificial Intelligence / Cognitive Science / relevant CS
programs.destination: Relevant AI, cognitive science, or CS conferences
programs.paperRequirement: Presentation is not required; the application form explicitly allows 'I am not presenting'.
programs.eligibility: AISB student members; membership must normally have been held for 3 months before applying.

programs.name: Ewing "Rusty" Lusk Travel Scholarship
programs.amount: Registration + up to $800 same-continent / $1,600 intercontinental travel
programs.paperRequirement: No accepted submission required; acceptance may strengthen an application.
programs.eligibility: Currently enrolled graduate students who are SIGHPC members and lack institutional support.
programs.payment: Registration paid directly; travel reimbursed after the conference.

programs.name: NeurIPS 2026 Financial Assistance
programs.amount: Registration and/or prepaid accommodation; amount depends on assignment/inventory
coverage: Prepaid accommodation in Atlanta, Sydney, or Paris where awarded
programs.paperRequirement: Accepted work is not mandatory; primary contributors to accepted NeurIPS work may receive priority.
programs.eligibility: Applicants for whom attendance would cause financial burden; evaluated holistically.
programs.payment: Registration/accommodation are generally provided directly rather than reimbursing travel.

programs.name: ICLR 2027 Financial Assistance — Watch
programs.amount: 2027 TBD; 2026 offered tiered prepaid or reimbursement support
coverage: Historically: travel reimbursement in some tiers
programs.paperRequirement: ICLR states anyone needing financial assistance can apply; authorship/contribution can affect priority but is not a universal requirement.
programs.eligibility: 2027 details TBD.

programs.name: AAAI-27 Student Scholar Volunteer Program
programs.amount: Partial travel support + complimentary registration if selected
notCovered: Full travel cost is not guaranteed
programs.paperRequirement: You must have submitted paper(s) to the conference, but the application opens before final acceptance and acceptance is not listed as an eligibility requirement.
programs.eligibility: Full-time undergraduate or graduate students who are AAAI members and have submitted paper(s), with advisor recommendation.

programs.name: ACM CCS 2026 Student Conference Grant
notCovered: Amount varies; postdocs are not eligible
programs.paperRequirement: The grant page does not require an accepted paper.
programs.eligibility: Undergraduate and graduate students; financial need is considered.
programs.membership: No membership requirement stated on the grant page.

programs.name: ACM SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Opportunity Travel Grant
programs.amount: Full conference pass + documented attendance-cost reimbursement for selected grantees
coverage: Documented attendance costs under ACM SIGGRAPH travel policy
notCovered: Only a small number of recipients are selected
programs.paperRequirement: No accepted paper is required.
programs.eligibility: Applicants from universities, NGOs, industry and government; students and early-career researchers are explicitly encouraged.
programs.membership: ACM SIGGRAPH membership required when funds are disbursed, not necessarily at application.

programs.name: CODS 2026 Student Travel Grant — Stage 1
programs.studentLevel: Full-time degree students incl. Master's / PhD
programs.amount: Up to INR 6,000; one tier also includes shared accommodation
programs.paperRequirement: Stage 1 is explicitly open regardless of whether the student is submitting a paper.
programs.eligibility: Full-time students enrolled in a degree-granting institution who can attend all conference days.
programs.payment: Grant with or without shared accommodation.

programs.name: CI + HCOMP 2026 SIGWEB Fair Access Travel Grant
notCovered: Funds are limited and may be exhausted
programs.paperRequirement: You may apply before acceptance; accepted presenters receive preference.
programs.eligibility: MSc/PhD students, postdocs and non-tenured professionals residing in eligible developing countries.
programs.membership: No membership requirement stated in the event call.

programs.name: ECML PKDD 2027 Student Support — Watch
programs.amount: 2027 TBD; 2026 offered up to €1,000 per student
programs.paperRequirement: 2027 TBD. In 2026, accepted-paper authorship was not stated as mandatory; scientific-program participation was one evaluation factor.
programs.eligibility: 2027 details TBD.

programs.name: ELLIS PhD & Postdoc Program — Conference Travel Support
programs.destination: Conference and research travel through the ELLIS network
programs.paperRequirement: No conference paper is required to be in the ELLIS PhD program.
programs.eligibility: ELLIS PhD/Postdoc program participants under the program's admission rules.

programs.name: ELLIS Doctoral Symposium Mobility Grant
programs.paperRequirement: No accepted conference paper is required; this is a doctoral symposium participation/mobility program.
programs.eligibility: ELLIS PhDs/postdocs and related network participants; external PhD applicants may be admitted when space permits.

programs.name: Google PhD Fellowship
programs.field: Computer Science / AI / ML and related research
programs.destination: Research and conference travel funded through fellowship
programs.eligibilityRegion: Africa / Australia-NZ / Canada-US / East Asia / Europe / India / Latin America / Southeast Asia
coverage: Travel expenses including overseas/conference travel in many regions
notCovered: Exact amount and nomination route vary by region
programs.paperRequirement: No conference paper requirement; this is a PhD fellowship.
programs.eligibility: PhD students under region-specific fellowship rules and nomination/application procedures.

programs.name: Microsoft Research Fellowship
programs.eligibilityRegion: Africa / Australia-NZ / Americas / Canada / Europe / India / East Asia / USA
notCovered: Funds are paid to the institution, not directly to the student
programs.paperRequirement: No conference paper requirement.
programs.eligibility: Active PhD students at accredited degree-granting institutions in eligible regions; challenge-specific criteria apply.

programs.name: Microsoft Research India PhD Award
programs.destination: Conference travel may be funded from the award
programs.paperRequirement: No conference paper requirement.
programs.eligibility: Outstanding graduate students in research areas relevant to Microsoft Research India; program-specific nomination rules apply.

programs.name: NVIDIA Graduate Fellowship
programs.field: AI / ML / Robotics / Vision / Systems / Accelerated Computing
programs.destinationCountry: Worldwide applicants; internship offices in multiple countries
notCovered: This is not primarily a conference-travel grant; current cycle is closed
programs.paperRequirement: No specific conference paper requirement; research/publication record is part of evaluation.
programs.eligibility: PhD students who have completed at least the first year and meet the program's research/internship requirements.

programs.name: Adobe India AI Research Fellowship
programs.field: Artificial Intelligence / Computer Vision / NLP / Human-centered AI
programs.destination: Research program; funding can support graduate research
notCovered: Official page does not specifically promise conference travel
programs.paperRequirement: No conference paper requirement.
programs.eligibility: Full-time PhD candidates at recognized Indian universities with at least 12 months remaining.

programs.name: ICLR 2026 Financial Assistance
programs.amount: Tiered: up to $1,500 reimbursement or prepaid registration + hotel in top tier
coverage: Visa fees/food/local transport can be eligible under reimbursement rules
programs.paperRequirement: Accepted main-conference paper was not mandatory; students/contributors and underrepresented groups were priority categories.
programs.eligibility: Students and early-career contributors with financial need.

programs.name: UAI 2026 Scholarship
programs.paperRequirement: Accepted UAI paper encouraged, but explicitly not required.
programs.eligibility: Participants in financial need.

programs.name: KDD 2026 Student Travel Award
notCovered: Award size depends on sponsor funding
programs.paperRequirement: No accepted paper needed to apply; publication acceptance may affect allocation.
programs.eligibility: Full-time students interested in data mining or ML research.

programs.name: SIGMOD/PODS 2026 Student Travel Grant
programs.field: Data Management / Data Systems / ML data
programs.amount: Partial stipend; amount depends on funds
notCovered: Students arrange their own travel/accommodation; award may be partial
programs.paperRequirement: Accepted paper not required; students without accepted papers doing relevant research are encouraged.
programs.eligibility: Full-time students worldwide; awardees must become SIGMOD members.
programs.membership: SIGMOD membership required by award time.

programs.name: SIGCOMM 2026 Student Travel Grants
programs.paperRequirement: Preference is explicitly given to applicants not presenting a paper.
programs.eligibility: GeoDiversity, N2Women and NSF-targeted applicant groups.

programs.name: ACM IMC 2026 Travel Grant
programs.amount: Significant offset of airfare, shared hotel, and registration
programs.paperRequirement: No accepted paper required; rejected-paper authors and early PhD students without support are explicitly prioritized.
programs.eligibility: Graduate students, postdocs and early-career researchers with limited funds.

programs.name: ACM CODASPY 2026 Student Travel Grant
programs.eligibilityRegion: Global subject to ACM sanctions rules
programs.paperRequirement: No accepted paper requirement is listed.
programs.eligibility: Selected undergraduate or graduate students worldwide with merit and financial need.
programs.payment: Reimbursement; registration can be covered via discount code.

programs.name: RecSys 2026 Registration Grant
programs.amount: Typically 50% registration; full waiver possible in exceptional cases
notCovered: Travel and lodging are not part of this specific grant
programs.paperRequirement: No accepted paper required.
programs.eligibility: Need-based, including lower-income/developing-country participants and Master's/PhD researchers lacking institutional support.

programs.name: ACL 2026 Diversity & Inclusion Subsidies
notCovered: Limited budget; reimbursement may require upfront payment
programs.paperRequirement: Presenting authors receive preference, but the subsidy call also invites students/researchers from underrepresented communities facing financial barriers generally.
programs.eligibility: Students/researchers with financial barriers; underrepresented communities and first-time attendees prioritized.

programs.name: EMNLP 2026 Diversity & Inclusion Subsidies
programs.paperRequirement: Presenting authors receive preference; the call broadly encourages students and researchers with financial hurdles to apply.
programs.eligibility: Developing-country researchers, marginalized communities, students and researchers with financial hurdles.
programs.membership: No general membership requirement to apply.

programs.name: IJCAI–AIJ 2026 Travel & Accessibility Grant
notCovered: Funding is limited and applicants are asked to seek local support first
programs.paperRequirement: Accepted paper not required; accepted technical-paper authors get preference if demand exceeds funds.
programs.eligibility: Students, junior scientists and scientists attending IJCAI–ECAI.

programs.name: EurAI Travel Grant for IJCAI–ECAI 2026
programs.paperRequirement: Being a paper author is a selection criterion, not stated as a basic eligibility requirement.
programs.eligibility: Affiliation with a European institution/university + membership in a EurAI national AI society, with exceptions case-by-case.
programs.membership: Membership in a EurAI member national AI society required.

programs.name: ECML PKDD 2026 Student Participation Support
notCovered: Public page does not specify an expense-by-expense list
programs.paperRequirement: Accepted-paper authorship is not stated as mandatory; scientific-program participation is one evaluation factor.
programs.eligibility: Students who may otherwise be unable to attend.

programs.name: AIxIA 2026 Student Travel Grant
programs.studentLevel: Bachelor / Master's / PhD / recent Bachelor-Master graduates
programs.paperRequirement: Accepted contributions are evaluation criteria, not eligibility requirements.
programs.eligibility: Eligible students/recent graduates who are AIxIA members and meet the call requirements.

programs.name: PASC26 Student Travel Grant
programs.amount: Up to $800 within Europe / $1,600 from another continent + registration
programs.paperRequirement: Contribution submission is favored but explicitly not required.
programs.eligibility: Undergraduate/graduate students who are SIGHPC members.

programs.name: SOSP 2026 Student Scholarship
programs.paperRequirement: No accepted paper requirement is stated.
programs.eligibility: Students enrolled at educational institutions worldwide; advisor must commit to covering travel.

programs.name: ISPASS 2026 Student Travel Grant
notCovered: Applicant/advisor must be able to cover excess costs
programs.paperRequirement: Students do not need to be authors/presenters on an accepted paper; authors/presenters receive higher priority.
programs.eligibility: Students/postdocs in fields covered by ISPASS with advisor support letter.

programs.name: AAMAS 2026 Student Attendance Scholarship
programs.paperRequirement: Accepted-paper authors receive priority, but the call explicitly says students without an accepted paper may be supported if funding permits.
programs.eligibility: Full-time students; attendance and student volunteering required if selected.

programs.name: KR 2026 Diversity & Inclusion Grant
coverage: Registration waiver and/or partial travel funding
notCovered: Budget is modest; applicants are encouraged to seek top-up funding
programs.paperRequirement: No accepted paper requirement is stated.
programs.eligibility: Attendees from groups/countries underrepresented in KR who lack means to attend.

programs.name: ICRA 2026 SPIRSE Student Travel Grant
notCovered: Only a few grants are awarded
programs.paperRequirement: Priority is given to students who would not otherwise attend, including students without an accepted paper.
programs.eligibility: Students interested in robotics standardization; no IEEE membership required to apply.
programs.membership: No membership required; memberships included in award.

programs.name: ACM womENcourage 2026 Participation Scholarship
programs.eligibilityRegion: Europe / Africa / Middle East / Azerbaijan / Kazakhstan
programs.paperRequirement: Accepted poster is not essential; some awards go to students showing exceptional interest and willingness to volunteer.
programs.eligibility: Students in ACM-W Europe region; computing or directly related field.
programs.membership: No ACM membership requirement stated for the participation scholarship.

programs.name: SREcon26 Europe/Middle East/Africa Student Grant
programs.paperRequirement: No presenter requirement.
programs.eligibility: Full-time students lacking sufficient funding.

programs.name: SIGHPC SC26 Student Travel Grant
programs.amount: Up to $800 North America / $1,600 intercontinental + registration
programs.paperRequirement: Applicants do not have to present at SC.
programs.eligibility: Students enrolled at accredited universities worldwide who are SIGHPC members.
